selection: All four failed requested-alternatives-1 development cases; two also failed HIP quality review. This is reuse, not held-out transfer.

arms.original: Exact original texts, fresh service control.
arms.direct: Fresh writer applies frozen updated skill to original plus question and source ledger. One explicitly requested measured alternative per case.
arms.rebuild: Separate fresh writer sees frozen updated skill, question and factual ledger with protected code/URLs, but not original prose. Writes an answer from that inventory. One output per case.

hypothesis: Removing original prose from the writer context may reduce anchoring on its wording while keeping factual coverage. Compare workflow as a whole; this does not isolate any sentence in SKILL.md.
sample_limit: No authentic user writing sample supplied, so the conditional voice instruction is inactive. No invented sample will be substituted.
quality_gate: Separate score-blind reviewer compares all8 candidates against sources and originals for correctness, relevance, clarity, qualifiers, code and useful coverage. Repair factual defects once if necessary, record both versions; never repair in response to scores during this batch.
measurement: Up to12 distinct full texts. Fresh paired GPTZero Basic in signed-in Chrome, same displayed model. Deduplicate byte-identical inputs before scanning. Save actual editor transforms and UI warnings. No padding, quotations, advanced mode or purchase.
stop: Complete the fixed batch, retain all outcomes. No post-score candidate selection or new cycles without a distinct hypothesis.
